csv_project_name: Design for Riverwalk Rehab Bike/Ped Scale Lighting Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Santa Cruz Public Works Department is soliciting proposals from qualified firms with expertise in Electrical Design work for the development of electrical construction plans and specifications. Affordable Housing and Sustainable Communities (AHSC) to fund the Riverwalk Rehab Bike/Ped Scale Lighting project. The project proposes installation of decorative streetlights and pavement improvements along the San Lorenzo Riverwalk between Riverside Avenue and the San Lorenzo Trestle Bridge. The City is seeking a licensed, in the State of California, electrical engineer to design and prepare electrical plans, specifications and cost estimate (including schedule of values) for the electrical engineering portion of the Riverwalk Rehab Bike/Ped Scale Lighting Project (c402509). The final design shall include wet signed sets of complete electrical working drawings, including electrical items quantities, and on-sheet electrical specifications to facilitate installation of decorative streetlights for the project
